overview: The screens, menus and keys the other mods here use to talk to you.
Press N for questions waiting on you, J for action menus, /pandorical mods for the rest.

15.17.0: A mod can put a button on the first page J opens, beside the menus rather than inside Server. Learning Blocks does.
An action menu button can wear a picture of a mod's own instead of an item. Particle Emote's buttons show the particles they throw.
Perspective on the Game menu offers the three views to pick from, instead of stepping to the next one.

The Server menu starts with Welcome, What's new and Mods. /pandorical changes shows what changed since you were last here, or what each mod changed last. Server wears a beacon on the menu of menus, and Game a grass block.
A menu button for somebody asks who by face, from everyone else online, instead of needing a name typed.
15.16.0: A server mod can draw a mob in its own shape: new parts, or the mob's own resized, still walking and fighting as it always did. Baby Skeletons uses it for skeletons shaped like babies.
15.15.0: A server mod's camera, like Redstone Photography's, takes its picture from your own screen, without the HUD or your hand, as F1 then F2 would.
15.14.0: Wide fence gates are drawn piece by piece as their blocks swing out, for More Doors.
Joined fence gates are drawn from one model per shape, turned to face the way the gate does.
15.13.0: A ladder or vine on a ship at sea climbs the same as one on land.
Blocks on a ship at sea can be clicked, for a mod that says which: Big Boats opens its doors, chests, furnaces and crafting tables this way.
15.12.0: Ops can trust players one by one with PvP, fire and lava, explosives, and hurting others' animals, on a page /pandorical trust opens.
Each switch has a default for everyone; PvP's is the server's own pvp gamerule.
15.11.0: A setting whose options are shapes can show the shape beside its name in the mods menu.
15.10.0: The mods screen puts the mods only you are running at the top, above the server's hundred.
A client-only mod like Sodium was listed all along, as row one hundred and nine.
15.9.0: Opening the notice tray puts the badge out, even if you answered nothing. Looking is enough.
It comes back when something new arrives.
On a controller the badge names your button instead of telling you to press a key.
15.8.0: The welcome is offered until you have actually read it, not just until it has been shown once.
Anyone who was busy when it first arrived gets it again on their next login.
15.7.0: The notice badge shows what is waiting, not just a bell.
15.6.0: The notice badge shrinks once you have opened the tray. The key is on it the first time only.
15.5.0: In the notice tray, summaries wrap, answers line up down one edge, and the time left shows.
15.4.0: Buttons that close a screen work again.
What changed since you were away wraps instead of running off the panel.
The notice badge names the key you actually have bound.
15.3.1: What changed since you were away is readable. It was grey on grey.
The notice badge sits above the hotbar instead of under it.
15.3.0: The notice badge moved to the bottom right, out of the crowded corner.
The notice tray reads as a list of questions, and has a way out.
15.2.0: The notice tray opens on N, or the d-pad's right on a controller.
The badge in the corner is readable and names its key.
15.1.1: Fixed the notice badge drawing as a sliver in the corner.
15.1.0: Notices: a mod can put a question to you in a tray of its own instead of in chat.
The death screen's buttons work on a client that has stopped ticking.
Horses turn the way you press, at a horse's pace.
Grass slabs no longer flash white as they are placed.
15.0.0: Action menus: grids of buttons on one key. Press J, or set your own.
The mods screen lists what you are running and can switch your own mods off.
Notices: questions from mods wait in a tray on N instead of scrolling past in chat.
